note: Written by hand to match what the review pass is expected to return for the demo store, so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with: paypal-doctor scan demo-store --llm record

findings.message: The webhook handler treats PAYMENT.CAPTURE.PENDING the same as PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED and marks the order paid. PENDING means PayPal has not credited the funds yet (eCheck, payment review); the capture can still be denied, and the shop has shipped by then.
